name: Beast Speaker Mastery (Mythic)
body:
You are able to drive your beast companion to perform amazing feats.

Prerequisite(s): Beast Speaker Mastery

Benefit(s): You are considered one level higher for all purposes related to the class feature that grants you a mount or companion; this stacks with the increase granted by Mythic Beast Speaker. Your beast companion also gains the recuperation base mythic ability. You may expend one use of your mythic power to allow your companion to use this ability to recover more quickly. You may expend one use of your mythic power as a full-round action to allow your beast companion to use the mythic version of any one feat it knows for 1 minute. If the mythic feat has effects that are not constant and require the use of mythic power, you must be adjacent to your beast companion (or riding it) and expend your mythic power to allow it to use these abilities. You can change the mythic feat your companion possesses by expending one use of mythic power; it may only gain one mythic bonus feat in this way.

Special: You can select any pact abilities that improve an animal companion, regardless of your path. You still must have a higher enough tier to select each path ability.
